title: Generalized conformal modules over the Virasoro conformal algebra
summary: This paper investigates generalized conformal modules over the Virasoro conformal algebra $Vir$, a notion originally defined by V.~Kac but largely unexplored in the literature. First, we present a twisted construction that produces new generalized conformal modules over any Lie conformal algebra from existing conformal modules.
